recommendation.reason: This non-agentic benchmark has strong attention and a best reported accuracy of 56.6%, with no supplied evidence of saturation.
risks: Solvability evidence is not established for every task.
Reward hacking and contamination defenses are not stated.
The automated verifier depends on external model judges; container integration needs confirmation.

release.quote: RISEBench++ evaluation code, figures, and a **60-case sample subset** are in [`RISEBench++/`](RISEBench++/).

tasks.quote: RISEBench++ expands the benchmark to **1,000 bilingual test cases** across **six reasoning dimensions, 12 subcategories, and 65 fine-grained task types**.

verifier.full_credit: High scores from dimension-specific evidence and scoring rubrics across reasoning, appearance consistency, and visual plausibility
